sections.heading: Fragrance & Beauty Gift Set Box FAQ
sections.text: Questions Fragrance & Beauty Gift Set Box FAQ How many products can one set box hold? Commonly three to five items in one row, each in its own cavity. Send the item list with sizes or samples and we lay out the insert on a 3D mock-up before the sample. Can the insert fit different shapes in one box? Yes. A bottle, a round compact and a soft puff can sit side by side; each cavity follows the item's outline and depth. Perfume set box or single perfume box? A set box holds several products in one long box. For one bottle with an atomizer, see the perfume box with bottle insert. What is the minimum order? 100 pcs per custom size. A physical sample takes 3–5 business days and bulk production 12–15 days after sample approval. Do you supply the bottles or cosmetics? No. We make and ship the empty boxes and inserts; products come from your own suppliers.
